summary: The ToolBit view provider now routes edit mode 1 to the standard Transform manipulator, so the tree-view Transform context-menu entry works on a tool bit in a document instead of opening the tool bit editor panel.

pages.reason: Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/view.py: ViewProvider.setEdit mode 1 now runs Std_TransformManip and unsetEdit only closes the panel for mode 0, so right-click Transform on a document tool bit opens the transform manipulator rather than the toolbit task panel
Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/view.py: change is to in-document tool bit editing modes, not to the ToolBitDock command or its panel
